targets.descriptor: The print is a collage-type composition rather than a simple repeat: large blown-up roses and peonies sit among faded photographic vignettes of faces and figures and lines of script and block lettering, all on a pale stone-beige ground. A dark near-black band runs the full length of the centre-front placket and continues around the collar, and further dark panels run down the shoulder-to-underarm/side seams and along the sleeve seams, so the garment reads as a light printed body framed by dark vertical edges. The sleeve widens gently from elbow to the wrist band, and the front hem is slightly shaped rather than cut straight across, with the placket buttons continuing down to that edge. The piece is shown on a headless torso form, so the sleeves and body hang with only the form's own volume behind them.
